title: Vegan Apricot Deopbap
description: A twist on traditional Korean rice bowl, this vegan deopbap recipe features sweet and tangy apricot flavors. It's a perfect comfort food for a cozy night in.
instructions: Rinse the Korean rice in a fine mesh strainer and drain well.
In a medium saucepan, heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the diced apricot and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the miso paste, vegan soy sauce, and rice vinegar.
Pour the miso mixture over the apricot and stir to combine.
Add the chopped green onions, sesame seeds, and toasted almonds to the saucepan.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, heat 1 cup of water over high heat.
Add the Korean rice to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and divide among bowls.
Top each bowl with the apricot mixture and serve immediately.
